notes.subject: ye / la
notes.rationale: Bamanankan copula and locative postposition supplied; Hebrew has no copula in the exclamation

notes.subject: מה אדיר שמך
notes.rationale: Hebrew exclamative 'how majestic your name'; rendered as embedded relative clause 'i tɔgɔ ye fɛn min ka josɛbɛ'

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: direct address to Yawe, closing refrain of the psalm

notes.subject: Matigi
notes.rationale: אדנינו 'our Lord/master' rendered Matigi, standard Bamanankan title for sovereign

translation: Yawe, an ka Matigi, i tɔgɔ ye fɛn min ka josɛbɛ dugukolo bɛɛ la!

tokens.gloss: fia (i tɔgɔ ye fɛn min ka josɛbɛ)
